summary: Straight-line 3DNow! packed-quaternion multiply. Reads the two packed 2-float halves of inputs a2 and a3, expands the first input's halves into duplicated lanes with MMX unpacks, forms the cross/dot product terms with sign-bit XOR (0x80000000) negation and pfsub/pfadd, combines them with pfacc into the two packed output halves, stores the result to a1, and exits the MMX state with _m_femms.

operations.description: Read the second packed half of input a3 into v3 (a3[1]) and of input a2 into v4 (a2[1]).
Expand the first input's first half a3->m64_u64 into duplicated lanes v6 and its second half v3 into duplicated lanes v7 using MMX unpack operations.

Form the first output packed half v8 by combining pfsub(pfmul(v6, v4), pfmul(pxor(v7, sign), a2->m64_u64)) with pfadd(pxor(pfmul(a3->m64_u64, v4), sign), pfmul(v3, a2->m64_u64)) via pfacc, where sign is the sign-bit XOR mask 0x80000000.
Form the second output packed half from the products v9 (pfmul(pxor(v6, sign), a2->m64_u64)), v10 (pxor(v3, sign)) and v11 (pfmul(a3->m64_u64, a2->m64_u64)) combined by pfadd/pfsub/pfacc.
Store the first output half v8 to a1->m64_u64 and the second output half to a1[1].m64_u64.
Exit the MMX/3DNow! execution state with _m_femms.

clean_pseudocode: // cross/dot product terms with sign-bit negation, combined by pfacc
out[0] = pfacc(pfsub(pfmul(splat(a0), b1), pfmul(pxor(splat(a1), sign), b0)),
out[1] = pfacc(pfadd(pfmul(pxor(splat(a0), sign), b0), pfmul(splat(a1), b1)),
